_about: Main settings for Goalscraper (data from OpenFootAPI's free plan). The full run is at run_time_local and a short evening update (results so far, postponements) at evening_time_local, Irish time. The model's learned adjustments live in data/model_state.json, not here. Each run scores today's remaining games and all of tomorrow's (days_ahead), and picks the top games per day; the app shows today's picks and switches to the next day at midnight.

international_pass_mark._about: Internationals start with a lower pass mark (national teams play few games, so their scores run lower). It rises 1 point for every 'games_per_point' international games Goalscraper has predicted and settled, up to 'end', and pauses while the model check flags internationals for review.

sections._about: Each section's 1-100 scale is set by the chance of the pick going wrong: 'fail_at_100' scores 100, 'fail_at_50' scores 50 (the pass mark), 'fail_at_1' scores 1. Easy Goals goes wrong on a 0-0; Misses if the team wins; Ballon d'Or if the team doesn't win; Raining Goals if either team fails to score.

starting_values._about: Where the model starts. The daily self-adjustment moves these within limits; see the Coverage tab.

requests._about: OpenFootAPI free plan: 5,000 requests a month. A normal day uses about 10-20; the first run uses more to collect the season so far.

thesportsdb._about: Free source of upcoming games for competitions where OpenFootAPI only has results (tsdb_id in competitions.json). Key 123 is TheSportsDB's free key; it allows about 30 requests a minute.

feed_fixes._about: OpenFootAPI's results-only feed files some leagues under the wrong competition. remap moves them to the right one; drop ignores copies of leagues already kept elsewhere. Only affects that feed (ids starting match_fd_). team_ids renames the club ids in a relabelled copy so the same club isn't counted twice.
